about: A second call from the same number while its calls still run: since #149 it opens like a first call, recalls nothing from the last one, and claims no results

returning.opening: This renter last called earlier today. The calls from their last call are still running. What you know: Wants up to $2,200 a month, 1 bedroom or more and around Bathurst Street. Turned down 701 Don Mills Rd (too far).

lines.say: Okay, I'll wait for your text then. Bye.
